'''Cucumber soup''' is a traditional [[Polish cuisine|Polish]] and [[Lithuanian cuisine|Lithuanian]] soup ({{langx|pl|Zupa ogórkowa}}, {{IPAc-pl|AUD|Pl-zupa_ogórkowa.ogg|'z|u|p|a|-|o|'g|ó|r|k|o|w|a}}).<ref name="Applebaum Crittenden Bialy Bialy 2012"/> It is  made from [[polish style pickled cucumber|sour, salted cucumbers]] and [[potato]].<ref name="Applebaum Crittenden Bialy Bialy 2012"/> Occasionally, [[rice]] is substituted for the potatoes.

Cucumber soup is also any [[soup]] using [[cucumber]]s as a primary ingredient, and is present in various [[cuisine]]s. The two major varieties are fresh cucumber soup and pickled cucumber soup.

A similar soup is also common in [[Russian cuisine|Russia]] and [[Ukrainian cuisine|Ukraine]], where it is known as ''[[rassolnik]]''. There is another cucumber based soup known as [[tarator]] in [[Bulgarian cuisine|Bulgaria]], which is served cold.
